2.body: Another headhunter messaged me on LinkedIn today offering twenty percent more base pay for basic analyst work across town. Meanwhile upper management here acts like replacing a broken centrifuge filter is a luxury perk. Hard to feel valued lately.

Quick reminder to update your pipeline stages before 4 PM. Also, funny side note - a recruiter from a Nordic logistics staffing firm called my desk phone trying to pitch roles to me while I was waiting for our freight prospect in Turku to sign their renewal.

Whoever made the dark roast in the third floor kitchen today deserves a medal. By the way, I am stepping out at noon to grab lunch with an old university friend who consults on port automation, ping my cell if the staging build breaks.

I don't keep a personal log of casual industry networking, so you should probably ask IT if you need specific records. Right now I'm just trying to get back to the Q3 Research budget forecast.
